milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The player must navigate near the chiseled sandstone blocks at the pyramid base and face them. Target is the center of the nearest chiseled sandstone wall (west face at ~5,1,10), which is the first wall visible when approaching the pyramid from spawn. Max distance 16 and facing tolerance 60 degrees models 'player can see the chiseled sandstone'.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The player must navigate near the furnace and face it. Target is the furnace at (~3,0,4), which is directly between spawn and the pyramid. Max distance 16 and facing tolerance 60 degrees models 'player can see the furnace'.

Uses count_in_box_at_least (kind='block', object='wall_torch') because the task requires placing torches on the pyramid structure. When torches are placed on the side of a block they become 'wall_torch'; when placed on top they remain 'torch'. We check for both by using two rules (either satisfies). A generous bounding box [3,0,3] to [17,7,17] covers the full pyramid with ±2 margin. Requiring at least 4 torches confirms intentional lighting action. Note: we check both 'torch' and 'wall_torch' since placement orientation varies.
